_readme: Every file here is applied history: its bytes may never change. A gen-* tool whose data moves
writes an append-only DELTA instead (<date>-<stem>.delta.generated.sql, last in the apply order).
When the Coordinator applies a delta, pin it here with "deltaOf": "<base file>" and its sha256
all eleven generated files then in the chain are frozen, a superset of the ones noted APPLIED.
